svg.title: How Sieve works
svg.desc: Sample text passes through three gates in turn — Find, then Require, then Exclude — and what survives becomes kept lines with captured fields. The Library feeds patterns into the gates, Proof cases hold them in place, Safety checks the pattern for catastrophic backtracking, and Ship exports it.

g.text: Static read plus a timed probe — does this pattern blow up?
19 targets. No lookaround in the flavor? A two-pass pipeline.
